channel.title: Morning Digest News
channel.description: Inquiry into New Zealand man who hid his kids in forest for years lambasts officials' actions

item.title: New York Yankees say Legionella bacteria found in stadium cooling tower not linked to outbreak
item.description: Bacteria that cause Legionnaires' disease have been found in a Yankee Stadium cooling tower in New York City

item.title: Mexico launches antitrust investigation over alleged monopolistic soccer practices
item.description: Mexico’s National Antitrust Commission has launched an investigation into potential monopolistic practices in domestic soccer

item.title: Kennedy Center board to propose new options for honoring Trump as center confronts solvency worries
item.description: The Kennedy Center Board of Trustees is planning to propose adding President Donald Trump’s name to the facility’s exterior in recognition of his saving the building from its “precarious fiscal position."

item.title: China bristles at Anthropic CEO’s 'fearmongering' about its AI development
item.description: China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs bristled at the Anthropic CEO’s call for the U.S. to curb China’s artificial intelligence capabilities as part of a wider argument for a global slowdown on AI development

item.title: Tech CEOs call for AI regulation. Trump and Congress are not rushing to act
item.description: The technology industry is urgently warning about the potential harm of artificial intelligence, but political inaction in Washington poses a challenge

item.title: Trump calls AI risks a 'hoax,' says there is a 'SICK conspiracy' against AI and data centers
item.description: President Donald Trump says he is a sufficient guardrail against rogue artificial intelligence, claiming that any efforts to limit the technology are part of a “SICK conspiracy.”

item.title: Costco raises price for Kirkland motor oil, sets purchase limit
item.description: Costco has raised the price of motor oil sold under its exclusive private-label brand as well as limited how much of it customers can buy weekly as oil prices climb yet again

item.title: Microsoft commits to sweeping AI privacy rules for students. Will other tech giants follow?
item.description: As the new school year kicks in, the debate around student AI use is raging

item.title: Gates Foundation warns AI could widen inequality as foundation pledges $1B to expand access
item.description: Bill Gates is warning technology companies and world leaders that they must act now to ensure artificial intelligence combats social inequities

item.title: 'Aura farming' trend inspired by video games is sweeping Latin America
item.description: Young people across Latin America are gathering on beaches, parks and other public spaces to take part in "aura battles," a trend that has moved from the internet to the real world

item.title: China can block citizens from leaving over national security or tech export violations
item.description: China has introduced new border control rules that could ban citizens from leaving the country if they engage in illegal activities threatening national or industrial security

item.title: Japanese utility execs resign over falsified quake safety data for 2 nuclear reactors
item.description: The president of Chubu Electric Power Co., Japan's third-largest utility, says he and the chairperson are resigning over manipulated earthquake safety data for two nuclear reactors

item.title: Saudi pipeline hit by drones will be out of service for weeks, further restricting oil flow
item.description: A crucial Saudi oil pipeline that was struck in an attack will mostly be out of service for weeks as the damage is repaired

item.title: US acknowledges for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space
item.description: The U.S. has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space

item.title: Inquiry into New Zealand man who hid his kids in forest for years lambasts officials' actions
item.description: A major inquiry into New Zealand man Tom Phillips, who hid his children in a forest for years before dying in a police shootout, criticizes officials for not taking the risks to the children seriously
